title: Jest #6912: TypeError in toBeInstanceOf on null or undefined value

error_signal.message: jest TypeError: Cannot read property 'constructor' of undefined when using toBeInstanceOf matcher on null or undefined value in expect matchers

ground_truth.root_cause_description: toBeInstanceOf accesses value.constructor without null check. When value is null/undefined, it throws TypeError instead of a proper matcher failure.
ground_truth.fix_description: Add null guard before accessing constructor property
